# lab: command reference

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

One CLI for the lab (issue #6). `lab` on a terminal opens a menu; `lab <command> --help` shows the same
text as these pages. Config: `cli/lab.yaml`; secrets stay in the `.env` files and are never printed.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`lab backup`](backup.md) | Back up zaphod's data (not in git) to marvin; list snapshots; nightly cron line (port of setup/backup-to-marvin.sh) |
| [`lab bench`](bench.md) | llama-bench on one zaphod card, llama-swap stopped meanwhile, logged (port of tuning/bench) |
| [`lab compare-skill`](compare-skill.md) | A/B test: does an instruction file change tool-use quality? (port of tuning/compare-skill) |
| [`lab enso`](enso.md) | The Enso agent container: build, setup, up, check, tui, shell, down |
| [`lab image-mode`](image-mode.md) | Lend zaphod's card 2 to ComfyUI, or give it back (port of hub/image-mode) |
| [`lab kl`](kl.md) | KL-divergence of a model file or setting vs the Q8_0 reference, logged (port of tuning/kl) |
| [`lab log`](log.md) | Log one result to MLflow and notify the phone (port of tuning/log) |
| [`lab manifest`](manifest.md) | Machine and software facts for test results (port of tuning/manifest.sh) |
| [`lab mcp`](mcp.md) | The MCP tool gateway (MCPJungle): status, setup |
| [`lab memory`](memory.md) | Shared memory (LocalRecall): sync the lab's notes |
| [`lab models`](models.md) | Download this machine's models into /srv/models and check their sha256 (port of setup/models.sh) |
| [`lab monitors`](monitors.md) | Add zaphod's network monitors to Beszel (port of hub/beszel-monitors.sh) |
| [`lab quality`](quality.md) | Tool-use quality test (tool-eval-bench), logged (port of tuning/quality) |
| [`lab series`](series.md) | Average, lowest, highest of repeated runs (MLflow tag series; port of tuning/series) |
| [`lab setup`](setup.md) | Machine setup: check which setup/host.sh steps are done |
| [`lab sort-log`](sort-log.md) | Write the hand-sorted tool-use misses to MLflow (port of tuning/sort-log) |
| [`lab speed`](speed.md) | Writing and 32K reading speed, medians of 3, logged (port of tuning/speed) |
| [`lab tbench`](tbench.md) | Terminal-Bench-Local (19 terminal tasks, pass@2), logged (port of tuning/tbench) |
| [`lab version`](version.md) | Show the lab build (git commit) and where its config is |
| [`lab webui`](webui.md) | Open WebUI: settings drift (and --sync), per-model settings |
